tools.name: get_competitive_profile
tools.description: Use when the user asks who competes with a company, what a competitor recently did, or for a competitive overview of a domain. Input a company domain or name and get a privacy-safe profile: firmographics, recent strategic moves (the existence of a shift + a was→now summary, with the real analysis date), and links to published reports/comparisons. Returns { covered: false } for companies IndustryLens doesn't publicly track.

params.name: name
params.description: Company name (e.g. 'Apollo'). Used when no domain is given.

params.name: domain
params.description: Company domain or homepage URL (e.g. 'apollo.io'). Preferred — most precise.

tools.name: list_competitor_moves
tools.description: Recent tracked strategic moves for one competitor, newest-first — the existence of each shift plus a was→now summary and the real analysis date (never a fabricated date). Returns { covered: false } for companies IndustryLens doesn't publicly track, and an empty list for covered companies with no moves detected yet.

params.name: limit
params.description: Max moves (default 10, max 50).

params.name: competitor
params.description: Competitor name or domain (e.g. 'Apollo' or 'apollo.io').

tools.name: find_competitors
tools.description: Given a company domain or name, return the other companies IndustryLens tracks in the same market. Returns { covered: false } for companies not publicly tracked.

params.name: name
params.description: Company name (e.g. 'Apollo'). Used when no domain is given.

params.name: limit
params.description: Max competitors (default 10, max 50).

params.name: domain
params.description: Company domain or homepage URL (e.g. 'apollo.io'). Preferred.

tools.name: list_reports
tools.description: Browse published competitive-intelligence reports. Filter by industry or target_role; results are ordered newest-first. Each returned item has a slug usable with get_report. URLs follow https://industry-lens.com/reports/<slug>.

params.name: limit
params.description: Max results (default 10, max 50).

params.name: industry
params.description: Industry filter, ILIKE match (e.g. 'hr tech', 'devops', 'fintech').

params.name: target_role
params.description: Target role filter, ILIKE match (e.g. 'marketing', 'sales', 'product').

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: Fetch the full body of a published report by slug. Returns the report's structured fields plus content_html (the canonical body). For a PDF, use pdf_url when present, or append .pdf to the URL.

params.name: slug
params.description: Report slug from list_reports (e.g. '/devops-hiring-q1-2026' or 'devops-hiring-q1-2026').

tools.name: list_comparisons
tools.description: Browse published competitor-vs-competitor breakdowns. Optionally filter by a competitor name (matches either side). Each item has a slug usable with get_comparison. URLs follow https://industry-lens.com/compare/<slug>.

params.name: limit
params.description: Max results (default 10, max 50).

params.name: competitor
params.description: Competitor name filter (matches either side, ILIKE).

tools.name: get_comparison
tools.description: Fetch the full structured body of a published competitor comparison by slug. Returns content_json (the structured breakdown: pricing, recent moves, positioning, displacement signals, when-to-choose, etc.) plus metadata.

params.name: slug
params.description: Comparison slug from list_comparisons.

tools.name: subscribe_to_newsletter
tools.description: Sign the user up for IndustryLens's weekly intelligence-report newsletter. Use this only after the user explicitly asks to subscribe — never subscribe an email without their direct, informed consent. The source argument is recorded for attribution and defaults to 'mcp'.

params.name: email
params.description: The email address the user explicitly asked to subscribe.

params.name: source
params.description: Where the request came from (e.g. 'mcp_claude_desktop'). Defaults to 'mcp'.

tools.name: get_competitor_moves_diff
tools.description: The dated CHANGE-FEED for one competitor: every real was→now strategic shift IndustryLens detected, newest-first, each stamped with its real analysis date (never a fabricated date). Use when the user asks what changed, what's new, or wants a timeline of a competitor's moves — optionally since a given date. Input a domain or name. Returns { covered: false } with a CTA for companies not publicly tracked.

params.name: name
params.description: Company name (e.g. 'Apollo'). Used when no domain is given.

params.name: limit
params.description: Max moves (default 20, max 50).

params.name: since
params.description: Optional ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Only moves analyzed on/after this date are returned.

params.name: domain
params.description: Company domain or homepage URL (e.g. 'apollo.io'). Preferred — most precise.

tools.name: get_pricing_changes
tools.description: Structured pricing/packaging changes IndustryLens has detected across the markets it tracks — each with a change_type, severity, materiality score, a plain-language summary, and the real detection date. Pass a `competitor` (name or domain) to scope to one company, or omit it for a market-wide recent pricing feed. No other public source exposes structured competitor pricing-diffs like this.

params.name: limit
params.description: Max changes (default 20, max 50).

params.name: since
params.description: ISO date lower bound for detection (e.g. '2026-01-01'). Defaults to 90 days ago.

params.name: competitor
params.description: Competitor name or domain (e.g. 'Apollo' or 'apollo.io'). Omit for a market-wide recent pricing feed.

tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: List the B2B SaaS markets (categories) IndustryLens monitors. Each item has a `slug` usable with get_market_landscape for the full category map. Ordered by name.

tools.name: get_market_landscape
tools.description: Given a market (a vertical slug or name), return the published category overview plus every player IndustryLens tracks in that market — the whole-CATEGORY map, not a self-selected competitor set. Returns the hub (title, abstract, tldr, hero_stats, url), the deduped list of players (name, domain, business_model), and `market_news` — the latest weekly market summary (narrative, top topics, new entrants, topic momentum, source URLs). Returns { covered: false } for markets IndustryLens doesn't publi

params.name: market
params.description: A vertical slug (exact) or market name (ILIKE), e.g. 'sales-intelligence' or 'sales intelligence'.

prompts.name: market_brief
prompts.description: Build a dated, cited competitive brief for one company using the public IndustryLens tools (get_competitive_profile + get_competitor_moves_diff).

prompts.name: compare_two
prompts.description: Produce a head-to-head comparison of two companies, preferring a published IndustryLens comparison and falling back to each company's profile.

resources.name: reports
resources.description: The catalog of published competitive-intelligence reports (slug, title, url). Read industrylens://reports/{slug} for a report's full body.
